title: 流水灯与呼吸灯
goal: 掌握 51 单片机 I/O 数字输出与延时函数：用同一电路分别实现流水灯（基础任务）与呼吸灯（进阶任务，软件 PWM 调光），理解 PWM 占空比控制亮度的原理
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：本课程实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。 本虚拟仿真实验基于上述最小系统板构建，可灵活扩展外设（LED、按键、上拉电阻、蜂鸣器、矩阵键盘、数码管、LCD1602、串口适配器等），是实物实验的有益补充——虚实结合、线上线下实验类似但不完全重复。

实验原理

LED 正极（A）接单片机引脚、负极（K）接 GND。引脚输出 1（高电平）时 LED 点亮，输出 0 熄灭。 P1 口是 8 位准双向口，直接写 P1 = 0x01; 即可让 P1.0 输出高电平。

接线表

元件连接
D1~D8 正极P1.0 ~ P1.7
D1~D8 负极GND

实验步骤

  1. 阅读样例代码，理解 led <<= 1 的移位效果
  2. 点击「编译」→「下载烧录」→ 观察流水灯
  3. 修改移位方向、延时时间，重新编译下载观察变化
  4. 修改为双向来回流水（进阶）

思考

1. 若把 delay_ms 的参数改大会看到什么？
2. 为什么 led == 0 时要重置为 0x01？

进阶任务：呼吸灯（同一电路、不同程序）

呼吸灯 = LED 亮度像呼吸一样缓慢渐亮再渐暗。51 单片机没有硬件 PWM，用软件 PWM 实现： 在一个极短的 PWM 周期内，控制"亮的时间"（占空比）从 0 渐增到 100 再渐减到 0——人眼看到的就是平滑的呼吸效果。

unsigned char duty, r;
while (1) {
    for (duty = 0; duty <= 30; duty++)        /* 渐亮：占空比 0→30 */
        for (r = 0; r < 20; r++) {
            P1 = 0x00; delay_ms(duty);          /* 亮 duty 份 */
            P1 = 0xFF; delay_ms(30 - duty);     /* 灭其余 */
        }
    for (duty = 30; duty > 0; duty--)           /* 渐灭：占空比 30→0 */
        for (r = 0; r < 20; r++) {
            P1 = 0x00; delay_ms(duty);
            P1 = 0xFF; delay_ms(30 - duty);
        }
}

原理要点：① 占空比 = 亮时间 / PWM 周期；② PWM 周期要短（几十 ms 内），变化才平滑；③ 呼吸范围只让部分 LED 亮（如 P1=0x01 只呼吸 D1）更直观。

思考（呼吸灯）

1. 为什么快速开关 LED 人眼看到的是"变暗"而不是"闪烁"？
2. 占空比上限从 30 改成 1 会有什么变化？

goalEn: Digital output and delay functions on the 8051: implement an LED chaser (basic) and a breathing light (advanced, software PWM) on the same circuit, and understand duty-cycle brightness control.
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs in this course use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com). This virtual experiment is built on the same boards and can be extended with peripherals (LEDs, buttons, pull-up resistors, buzzer, matrix keypad, 7-segment displays, LCD1602, UART adapter, etc.) — a useful complement to the physical labs: similar but not identical.

Principle

The LED anode (A) connects to the MCU pin and the cathode (K) to GND. Outputting 1 (high) lights the LED; 0 turns it off. P1 is an 8-bit quasi-bidirectional port — writing P1 = 0x01; drives P1.0 high.

Wiring

PartConnection
D1–D8 anodesP1.0 ~ P1.7
D1–D8 cathodesGND

Steps

  1. Read the sample code and understand the shift effect of led <<= 1
  2. Click "Build" → "Flash & Run" and watch the chasing LEDs
  3. Change the shift direction and the delay, rebuild and observe
  4. (Advanced) make the light bounce back and forth

Reflection

1. What do you see if the delay_ms argument is made much larger?
2. Why reset to 0x01 when led == 0?

Advanced: breathing light (same circuit, different program)

A breathing light fades an LED in and out slowly. The 8051 has no hardware PWM, so we use software PWM: within a short PWM period, sweep the "on time" (duty cycle) from 0 up to maximum and back — the eye perceives a smooth fade.

unsigned char duty, r;
while (1) {
    for (duty = 0; duty <= 30; duty++)        /* fade in: duty 0→30 */
        for (r = 0; r < 20; r++) {
            P1 = 0x00; delay_ms(duty);          /* on for duty units */
            P1 = 0xFF; delay_ms(30 - duty);     /* off for the rest */
        }
    for (duty = 30; duty > 0; duty--)           /* fade out: duty 30→0 */
        for (r = 0; r < 20; r++) {
            P1 = 0x00; delay_ms(duty);
            P1 = 0xFF; delay_ms(30 - duty);
        }
}

Key points: ① duty = on time / PWM period; ② keep the PWM period short (tens of ms) so the fade is smooth; ③ letting only one LED breathe (e.g. P1=0x01, D1 only) is easier to observe.

Reflection (breathing light)

1. Why does fast switching look like "dimming" rather than "flickering"?
2. What changes if the duty cap drops from 30 to 1?
